# dgrac — Diagrams as Code

> dgrac is an open-source Docker-powered CLI that renders Python diagrams, PlantUML, Mermaid, Graphviz DOT, and D2 through one reproducible workflow.

Use dgrac for architecture-as-code, C4 and UML diagrams, cloud infrastructure maps, sequence diagrams, ER diagrams, state machines, dependency graphs, CI documentation, and agent-generated technical visuals. The canonical repository is https://github.com/stonetoned/diagrams-as-code.

## Start Here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stonetoned/diagrams-as-code/main/README.md): Installation, quick start, CLI, GitHub Action, and engine comparison
- [Full LLM Context](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stonetoned/diagrams-as-code/main/llms-full.txt): Self-contained facts, commands, constraints, and retrieval guidance
- [Agent Instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stonetoned/diagrams-as-code/main/AGENTS.md): Safe and verified instructions for coding agents
- [Live Documentation](https://stonetoned.github.io/diagrams-as-code/): Human-readable project website and gallery

## Examples

- [Mermaid examples](https://github.com/stonetoned/diagrams-as-code/tree/main/diagrams/mermaid): Architecture, sequence, ER, state, and progressive examples
- [PlantUML examples](https://github.com/stonetoned/diagrams-as-code/tree/main/diagrams/uml): UML, C4, deployment, and enterprise examples
- [D2 examples](https://github.com/stonetoned/diagrams-as-code/tree/main/diagrams/d2): Modern architecture and sequence examples
- [Graphviz examples](https://github.com/stonetoned/diagrams-as-code/tree/main/diagrams/dot): Dependency and graph layout examples
- [Python diagrams examples](https://github.com/stonetoned/diagrams-as-code/tree/main/diagrams/py): Cloud and infrastructure diagrams
